one_month_reasoning: Arista's own Q3 2026 report is scheduled for Nov 2, 2026 after the close (Zacks, src 16), i.e. just outside the Oct 30 window, so no company earnings print falls inside it. Inside the window: hyperscaler Q3 reports in the last week of October (Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon), whose 2027 capex commentary is the main sector read-through (2027 capex consensus ~$1.3T for six hyperscalers, src 15), and pre-earnings positioning. The stock is ~5% below its $214.89 high after S&P 100 inclusion (Sep 21) and heavy insider selling (~$746M over 90 days, src 8). Hyperscaler capex commentary has skewed toward raises all year, a mild positive, but the pre-print run-up risk is two-sided. I stay near-symmetric: lognormal with median ~$204.8 (tiny positive drift) and monthly sigma 15% (54% annual / 3.5).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$6.00 x 34x = $204) and EV/NTM sales (~$18.5B x 13x + ~$20B net cash over 1.28B shares = $203), rounded to $205.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS as of Sep-2027 ~$6.00 (2027 consensus $5.19 rolled forward ~3 quarters at ~20% growth) x 34x forward P/E (down from ~44x today as growth slows from ~40% to ~20%)

inputs_detail.derivation: $5.19 FY27 grown ~20-22% (consensus 2028 revenue growth, src 6) gives FY28 ~$6.3; NTM at Sep-2027 = 1/4 FY27 + 3/4 FY28 ~ $6.0. Q3 guide EPS $1.06-1.08 (src 1) is consistent with a ~$4.3 annualized run rate now.

Today ~44x forward vs Cisco ~21x and Ciena ~34x (src 6). With growth decelerating to ~20% and CFO saying the AI cycle is 2.5-3 years in, I assume the multiple compresses about a quarter, to Ciena-like levels.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep-2027 ~$18.5B x 13x EV/sales + ~$20B cash / 1.28B diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: 1/4 x $16.2B + 3/4 x $19.8B ~ $18.9B, haircut slightly for supply risk to $18.5B.
Market cap ~$258B (src 8) less $13.3B cash (src 1) = ~$245B EV over ~$14.5B NTM revenue = ~17x today; compressed to 13x in line with the P/E derating assumption.
$13.3B reported plus ~$6-7B of annual free cash flow (H1-26 OCF $2.8B, capex $84M, no buybacks).

bear.story: AI capex digestion in 2027 or Nvidia Spectrum-X and Celestica white-box share gains (Dell'Oro has Arista third in AI back-end Ethernet) cut 2027-28 growth to low teens. Gross margin keeps sliding and the multiple falls to ~25x on ~$5.5-6 NTM EPS. The long qualification and lead-time window gives customers time to qualify alternatives (TechCache).

base.story: FY26 lands at ~$12.7B+ and 2027 grows ~20% with FY27 EPS ~$5.2-5.5. Hyperscaler capex near $1T+ in 2027 sustains demand, and supply commitments of ~$9.7B plus $6.9B deferred revenue give visibility. EPS growth is mostly offset by multiple compression from ~41x to ~34-35x NTM.

bull.story: Supply easing unlocks the deferred backlog, and 2027 revenue beats the ~$16B consensus toward $17-18B. The AI fabric target rises again, front-end refresh broadens, and scale-up Ethernet optionality for 2028 keeps the multiple at ~40x+ on NTM EPS of $6.5-7.

thesis_break_reason: $140 is ~31% below today, below the 2026 range mid and about 23x my Sep-2027 NTM EPS. A price there most likely means the market is pricing a real 2027 capex digestion, a large hyperscaler customer shifting to Nvidia or white-box switching, or a guide-down/deferred-revenue unwind, rather than ordinary 54%-vol noise around a ~$205 value.

reasoning: Fundamentals are strong. Q2-26 revenue was $3.04B (+37.7%), non-GAAP EPS $1.02, the FY26 guide was raised to ~$12.6B (+40%), deferred revenue is $6.9B, cash $13.3B, and no buybacks (src 1). Newsletters (src 2-4) and the X read-through snippet (src 5) agree demand exceeds supply, with supply commitments near $9.7B. Alt-data backs that up: job postings up ~29% and headcount +14% YoY (src 10-11). There are cautions too. Dell'Oro and IDC (src 12-13) show Nvidia and Celestica ahead of Arista in AI back-end Ethernet, the CFO frames the AI cycle as 2.5-3 years in (src 6), insiders sold ~$746M in 90 days (src 8), and Reddit attention is low (36th percentile, src 9), so this is not a retail-crowded name. The prediction-market lead on 2027 hyperscaler capex resolved N/A with the creator citing a ~$1T consensus, so I treat it only as a pointer; the S&P/UBS forecasts of $1.3-1.45T (src 15) are the numbers. Valuation: at ~41x NTM EPS the stock already discounts consensus. Rolling EPS forward a year (~$6 NTM) at a compressed 34x gives ~$204, and the EV/sales cross-check gives ~$203, so fair value is ~$205, about today's price and below the sell-side average target of ~$226-242 (src 7-8). The forecast is a three-scenario lognormal mixture: bear median $150 (25%, sigma 0.40), base $212 (50%, sigma 0.28), bull $275 (25%, sigma 0.30). That gives a median ~$210, P(>=204) ~54%, and an effective spread near 45-50%, a bit below the 54% realized vol because the stock is now a $260B S&P 100 megacap. Research was limited: X was blocked (HTTP 402), paywalled Substacks were read only in preview, and no option data was used.
